title: Candy Oven
about: Building a candy-producing stage prop that became the beginning of lasting friendships.
description: This track remembers building the candy oven with Lauren and Will, starting with a metal shelf and turning it into a working stage effect with wood, screws, lights, fans, wiring, and a hidden crew. Paul and Shawn checked in as the project came together, while the three of us each contributed different pieces. During the show, the front could flip and candy would pour through on cue. What lasted longest, though, wasn't the prop itself but the friendships that grew while we built it.

Lyrics: Boards and screws spread on the floor,
Paul and Shawn would walk on by,
Piece by piece we shaped the frame,
By week's end it had a name.
Out of wood and borrowed dreams.
Flip the front and hide the crew,
When the music hit its cue,
Three of us with different parts,
Building more than props and arts.
I ran lights and powered fans,
Helping bring the show to play.
Out of wood and borrowed dreams.
Flip the front and hide the crew,
When the music hit its cue,
Can become what life still fills.
Not just lumber, screws, and paint,
Some things time can never taint.
Sometimes they start with building things.
It had changed the three of us quietly.
Years have passed, we're still around,
